source.title: Mid-Year Population Estimates, England and Wales, June 2025

tables.MYE5: MYE5: Population density for local authorities in England and Wales, mid-2011 to mid-2025
tables.MYE6: MYE6: Median age of population for local authorities in England and Wales, mid-2011 to mid-2025

units.areaSqKm: Land area in square kilometres, as published in MYE5 (column "Area (sq km)"). The sheet is in square kilometres, so no conversion from hectares or any other unit is made.
units.densityPerSqKm: Usual residents per square kilometre of land at mid-2025, as published in MYE5 (column "2025 people per sq. km"), rounded by ONS to a whole number.
units.medianAge: Median age in years at mid-2025, as published in MYE6, to one decimal place.
units.population: Estimated population mid-2025 from MYE5, checked equal to MYE4 for every row.

sourceNotes.rounding: Rounding: the population density estimates and area measurements are displayed rounded to the nearest integer though calculations have been performed on the unrounded data.
sourceNotes.definitions: Definitions: Standard Area Measurements (SAM) data used reflect the position as at January 2025 for England, Wales and Scotland. Land area measurements, excluding inland water, have been used in compiling these population density figures. Information on this is available from the ONS geography portal.
sourceNotes.changes: Changes: the area measurements are a definitive set derived from boundaries maintained by Ordnance Survey and Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland. The current measurements may differ from those published previously in tables, publications, or other statistical outputs, even allowing for boundary changes or changes to the physical structure of the land because of improvements to the source of the data.

usage: Area, density and median age for each local authority, as ONS publishes them. Nothing is estimated, interpolated or borrowed from another area.
